name: C# Polyglot Notebooks
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; python -m pip install --upgrade pip --no-input; python -m pip install --no-input --user jupyterlab nbconvert; dotnet tool install -g Microsoft.dotnet-interactive || dotnet tool update -g Microsoft.dotnet-interactive; dotnet interactive jupyter install'
